form.label: SCUBA
form.description: Deep Dive - Track activity for a specific user, including logins, removable media, actions/processes, print jobs, etc.

search.query: index=winevents source="wineventlog:security" user=$user_token$ (EventCode=4624 Security_ID="PROGRAM*" Logon_Type=2 OR Logon_Type=7 OR Logon_Type=10) | dedup _time host user | eval Logon_Type_Description=case(Logon_Type==2, "Interactive", Logon_Type==7, "Unlock", Logon_Type==10, "Remote Interactive") | table _time host Logon_Type_Description | sort -_time

index=winevents source="wineventlog:security" EventCode=4625 user=$user_token$ Logon_Type=2 OR Logon_Type=7 OR Logon_Type=10 | dedup _time | eval Logon_Type_Description=case(Logon_Type==2, "Interactive", Logon_Type==7, "Unlock", Logon_Type==10, "Remote Interactive") | table _time host Logon_Type_Description Failure_Reason

index=nix sourcetype=audit_log op="PAM:authentication" res=success acct="$user_token$" | eval Method=case(exe="/usr/bin/sudo", "Sudo", exe="/usr/sbin/sshd", "SSH", exe="/usr/sbin/sshd", "SSH", exe="/usr/lib/gdm3/gdm-session-worker", "GNOME", exe="/usr/libexec/gdm-session-worker", "GNOME", exe="/usr/bin/su", "SU", exe="/usr/lib/policykit-1/polkit-agent-helper-1", "PolicyKit") | table _time host Method | sort -_time

index=nix sourcetype=audit_log op="PAM:authentication" res=failed acct="$user_token$" | eval Method=case(exe="/usr/bin/sudo", "Sudo", exe="/usr/sbin/sshd", "SSH", exe="/usr/sbin/sshd", "SSH", exe="/usr/lib/gdm3/gdm-session-worker", "GNOME", exe="/usr/libexec/gdm-session-worker", "GNOME", exe="/usr/bin/su", "SU", exe="/usr/lib/policykit-1/polkit-agent-helper-1", "PolicyKit") | table _time host Method | sort -_time

div.h1: Windows External Devices Recognized by System

table.title: External Devices - System logs do NOT correlate to specific users, this panel filters for hosts that the user has logged into

search.query: index=winevents EventCode=6416 (Class_Name="WPD" OR Class_Name="CDROM" OR Class_Name="Camera" OR Class_Name="Image" OR Class_Name="TapeDrive" OR Class_Name="USBDevice" OR Class_Name="WCEUSBS") [ search index=winevents source="wineventlog:security" user="$user_token$" (EventCode=4624 Security_ID="PROGRAM*" Logon_Type=2 OR Logon_Type=7 OR Logon_Type=10) | dedup host | table host ] | table _time host Class_Name Device_Name Device_ID

div.h1: Linux - External Devices Recognized by System

table.title: dmesg (Diagnostic Messaging Log) for hosts the user was logged into

search.query: index=nix sourcetype=dmesg "New USB device found" OR ("usb" AND "Manufacturer:") OR ("usb" AND "Product:") [ search index=nix sourcetype=audit_log op="PAM:authentication" res=success acct="$user_token$" | dedup host | table host ] | stats list(_raw) AS _raw by _time host | table _raw _time host

table.title: Removable Storage - Windows OS automatically tags devices as removable storage in event logs. Check the device to verify it is not a secondary drive/fixed media.

search.query: index=winevents TaskCategory="Removable Storage" user="$user_token$" EventCode=4663 OR EventCode=4656 | eval Result=case(Keywords="Audit Success", "Success", Keywords="Audit Failure", "Failure") | stats count latest(_time) AS _time by host user Process_Name Object_Type Object_Name Result | table _time host user Process_Name Object_Type Object_Name Result count | sort -_time

table.title: /dev - /media - /mnt - Commands executed in/pointed to these directories

search.query: index=nix sourcetype=audit_log type=EXECVE | eval arg0=urldecode(ltrim(replace(a0,"([a-fA-F0-9]{2})","%\1"),"0x")) | eval arg0=if(isnull(arg0), a0, arg0) | eval arg1=urldecode(ltrim(replace(a1,"([a-fA-F0-9]{2})","%\1"),"0x")) | eval arg1=if(isnull(arg1), a1, arg1) | eval arg2=urldecode(ltrim(replace(a2,"([a-fA-F0-9]{2})","%\1"),"0x")) | eval arg2=if(isnull(arg2), a2, arg2) | eval arg3=urldecode(ltrim(replace(a3,"([a-fA-F0-9]{2})","%\1"),"0x")) | eval arg3=if(isnull(arg3), a3, arg3) | eval cmdline=coalesce(arg0, "") + " " + coalesce(arg1, "") + " " + coalesce(arg2, "") + " " + coalesce(arg3, "") | eval cmdline=trim(replace(cmdline, "\s+", " ")) | join msg [ search index=nix sourcetype=audit_log type=SYSCALL | table msg pid exe ] | join msg [ search index=nix sourcetype=audit_log type=CWD | table msg cwd ] | join pid [ search index=nix sourcetype=audit_log type=USER_ACCT | table pid acct ] | search cwd="*/dev*" OR cwd="*/media*" OR cwd="*/mount*" OR cwd="*/mnt*" OR cmdline="*mount*" OR cmdline="*USB*" OR cmdline="*mnt*" OR cmdline="*dev*" OR cmdline="*media*" | search acct="$user_token$" | table _time host acct cwd cmdline | sort - _time

table.title: Account Management - Includes actions taken by/to the target user

search.query: index=winevents (user="$user_token$" OR src_user="$user_token$") AND (EventCode=4720 OR EventCode=4726 OR EventCode=4725 OR EventCode=4722 OR EventCode=4740) | dedup src_user msad_action user | rename src_user AS "Admin Account" | rename msad_action AS Action | table _time "Admin Account" Action user | sort -_time

table.title: Account Management - For local Linux accounts only

search.query: index=nix sourcetype=audit_log type=EXECVE | eval arg0=urldecode(ltrim(replace(a0,"([a-fA-F0-9]{2})","%\1"),"0x")) | eval arg0=if(isnull(arg0), a0, arg0) | eval arg1=urldecode(ltrim(replace(a1,"([a-fA-F0-9]{2})","%\1"),"0x")) | eval arg1=if(isnull(arg1), a1, arg1) | eval arg2=urldecode(ltrim(replace(a2,"([a-fA-F0-9]{2})","%\1"),"0x")) | eval arg2=if(isnull(arg2), a2, arg2) | eval arg3=urldecode(ltrim(replace(a3,"([a-fA-F0-9]{2})","%\1"),"0x")) | eval arg3=if(isnull(arg3), a3, arg3) | eval cmdline=coalesce(arg0, "") + " " + coalesce(arg1, "") + " " + coalesce(arg2, "") + " " + coalesce(arg3, "") | eval cmdline=trim(replace(cmdline, "\s+", " ")) | join msg [ search index=nix sourcetype=audit_log type=SYSCALL | table msg pid exe ] | join pid [ search index=nix sourcetype=audit_log type=USER_ACCT | table pid acct ] | search acct="$user_token$" AND (cmdline="*usermod*" OR cmdline="*useradd*" OR cmdline="*userdel*" OR cmdline="*passwd*" OR cmdline="*chage*") | table _time host cmdline | sort - _time

table.title: This captures events for objects that have specific audit permissions listed. Process Creation events will capture more objects within the Command Line.

search.query: index=winevents user="$user_token$" Object_Type="$object_type$" EventCode=4663 OR EventCode=4656 | eval Result=case(Keywords="Audit Success", "Success", Keywords="Audit Failure", "Failure") | stats count latest(_time) AS _time by host user Object_Name Result | rename Object_Name AS "Object Name" | table _time host user "Object Name" Result count | sort -_time

table.title: Drilldown - Select row to see process command line

search.query: index=winevents sourcetype=security New_Process_Name="$process_type$" user="$user_token$" | stats count latest(_time) AS _time BY host New_Process_Name | table _time host New_Process_Name count | sort - count

table.title: Drilldown Results - Select process name to the left to populate

search.query: index=winevents sourcetype=security New_Process_Name=$process_token|s$ user="$user_token$" host=$host_token$ | table Process_Command_Line | sort - _time

table.title: For monitoring prints to devices as well as 'Print to PDF' - Windows OS often duplicates print job events due to internal logging configurations

search.query: index=winevents source=job user=$user_token$ | table _time host user printer document size_bytes total_pages page_printed
